Not here. A federal employee can do all three and keep collecting a paycheck — then retire on ninety percent of that pay for the rest of their life, with full medical covered. No performance review stops it. No manager's word is final. The job was never designed to be lost.

Sam Walton ran Walmart the opposite way: half of his working life, on foot, inside his own stores and his rivals'. One company is a case study now. The other doesn't exist. Being in charge and knowing what's happening on the ground are not the same skill.
